reviewed_areas.area: Historical updater and native package preparation
reviewed_areas.impact: The actual installed official older updater is exercised. The new pre-unpack guard preserves the installed older payload and VPN before explicit recovery.
reviewed_areas.limitations: Process-local discovery and TLS download fixture supplies exact official package bytes. The older downloader requires preservation of an exact stale temporary file before its unchanged retry.

reviewed_areas.impact: Recognized generated files are adopted only by a reviewed digest-bound migration that preserves the original client and keys. Active, changed, custom or ambiguous states are refused.
reviewed_areas.limitations: Official recognized templates with disposable credentials. Interrupted I/O and resume were tested; process-kill and power-loss durability are outside this claim.

reviewed_areas.area: Persistent filesystem identity and encrypted VPN traffic
reviewed_areas.impact: Original file content and inode identity survive reboot. A supplemental owned-manifest scenario also verifies a real device-number change, unchanged UUID identity, encrypted bidirectional traffic and VPN NAT.
reviewed_areas.limitations: The supplemental modern profile needs three narrowly scoped operator forwarding rules for the probe. No automatic repair of unrelated operator firewall policy is claimed.

reviewed_areas.impact: Standalone uninstall, independent APT remove, APT purge and remove followed by administrator edits and deferred purge are verified separately. Exact historical entries are retired while administrator behavior remains effective after reload and reboot. Same-version reinstall and signed updater rejection cases pass.
reviewed_areas.limitations: The authenticated offline updater case executes the staged candidate CLI. The distinct first-hop cases execute the installed historical updater.

reviewed_areas.area: Historical service, firewall and optional-feed recovery
reviewed_areas.impact: Exact former product service templates and firewall entries are retired without deleting shared resources. Separate removal archives verify independent Fail2ban protection, administrator files and packet behavior after reload and reboot. Optional OSINT disagreement no longer blocks installation when authenticated primary feeds remain valid; explicit refresh and malformed data retain their failure boundaries.
reviewed_areas.limitations: Ownership is established by exact recognized content and reviewed recovery plans. Custom and ambiguous state is preserved. Feed behavior uses isolated process-local HTTPS fixtures, not a live external-feed availability claim.

reviewed_areas.impact: Exact signed runtime bytes, complete source identities, five current product checks and fresh native signatures support the reviewed Patch scope. The prior accepted IVV retains its original identity.
reviewed_areas.limitations: No fresh all-platform lifecycle, HA endurance, live intelligence-feed or broad performance campaign. Production host acceptance remains separate.
